Title: Diverticulitis: Think It's Only Your Grandparents' Problem? - 3 Habits That Lower Your Risk

Description:
Complicated diverticulitis cases in Americans under 50 rose from 18.5% to 28.2% between 2005 and 2020 — it's no longer just an older adult's condition. A low-fiber diet is the biggest driver, and women are affected more than men. You don't need to avoid nuts, seeds, or popcorn (that's a myth, per Harvard and Cleveland Clinic). Focus on fiber (25-35g/day), enough water, and regular exercise instead.
